mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.board_sq AS sq, b.board_ttl AS ttl, u.user_nm AS userNm, b.board_type_cd AS boardTypeCd, b.board_created_at_dtm AS createdAt, b.board_view_cnt AS viewCnt, b.board_comment_cnt AS commentCnt, b.board_recommend_cnt AS recommendCnt, CASE WHEN b.board_type_cd = 1401 THEN NULL ELSE b.board_adopt_status_cd END AS boardAdoptStatusCd, b.board_description_edt AS description, 'BOARD' AS mainType FROM TBL_BOARD_M b JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON b.user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE b.board_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND b.board_type_cd != 1403 UNION ALL SELECT a.answer_sq AS sq, a.answer_ttl AS ttl, u.user_nm AS userNm, 1404 AS boardTypeCd, a.answer_created_at_dtm AS createdAt, a.answer_view_cnt AS viewCnt, a.answer_comment_cnt AS commentCnt, a.answer_recommend_cnt AS recommendCnt, CASE WHEN a.answer_is_adopted_yn = 'Y' THEN 1502 ELSE 1504 END AS boardAdoptStatusCd, a.answer_description_edt AS description, 'ANSWER' AS mainType FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S a JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON a.user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE a.answer_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ) AS unified WHERE 1=1 AND boardTypeCd IN #{t}
ORDER BY boardTypeCd ttl userNm boardAdoptStatusCd viewCnt recommendCnt createdAt ${sortOrder} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT b.board_sq AS sq, b.board_ttl AS ttl, b.board_description_edt AS description, u.user_nm AS userNm, b.board_type_cd AS boardTypeCd FROM TBL_BOARD_M b JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON b.user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE b.board_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND b.board_type_cd != 1403 UNION ALL SELECT a.answer_sq AS sq, a.answer_ttl AS ttl, a.answer_description_edt AS description, u.user_nm AS userNm, 1404 AS boardTypeCd FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S a JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON a.user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE a.answer_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ) AS unified WHERE 1=1 AND boardTypeCd IN #{t}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BOARD_M SET board_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE board_sq = #{sq}
UPDATE TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S SET answer_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE answer_sq = #{sq}
UPDATE TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_S SET comment_is_deleted_yn = 'Y', comment_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE comment_sq = #{commentSq}
